question: Per-node search cost of hidden-128 vs hidden-64 NNUE, isolated from eval-function differences

method.twin_construction: From models/cycle_000098_quant.nnue (h64), built a hidden-128 PIENNQ01 net computing the identical function: duplicate all 64 hidden-major w1 rows, duplicate b1, duplicate w2, double b2, halve w2_scale. Loader reads hidden_dim from the file header, so no Rust changes were needed.
method.identity_check: go depth 9 on 6 positions (startpos, 4 middlegames, 1 endgame): node counts and bestmoves bit-identical 6/6, confirming identical search trees.
method.speed_protocol: UCI, Threads 1, Hash 256, UseNNUE true, EvalBlend 100, go movetime 3000 per position, 6 positions x 2 interleaved rounds per net, NPS = nodes / wall-clock.
method.engine_build: cargo release, -C target-cpu=native, branch campaign-v2 (post-S2 baseline)
method.hardware: Apple M-series Mac (NEON auto-vectorization); production boxes are x86 AVX2 - re-measure there before final capacity decisions, ratio expected similar or slightly better for h128

results.elo_equivalent_speed_penalty_estimate: 15-20 Elo at fixed time (log2(0.809) = -0.31 doublings x ~50-70 Elo/doubling)

kernel_facts.simd: All NNUE kernels are scalar Rust (i8 weights, i16/i32 accumulators) auto-vectorized by LLVM under target-cpu=native; no hand-written intrinsics. quant.rs marks SIMD feature-flag paths as future work. Both widths share the same code path; hot loops are O(hidden) so h128 doubles eval work but not movegen/TT/make-unmake.
kernel_facts.hot_loops: apply_delta (feature-major w1 add/sub over hidden), eval_from_acc (w2 dot over relu(acc)), refresh

related_quality_evidence.frozen_data_prescreen: h128 val loss 0.684495 vs h64 0.688017 (+0.51% relative) on identical data, one epoch, fresh init

pure_network_blunder_protocol_20260807.protocol: 300 games each, depth 3 greedy, blend 100, book openings, seed 20260821, judged by PST engine depth 5
pure_network_blunder_protocol_20260807.verdict: v4 learner is weaker than the cycle-98 incumbent on pure-network play after 22 cycles; the h64 loop is not producing better networks
